title: MojoBPF diagnostic
description: Stable six-field diagnostic record: a frozen machine-readable code, the raising stage, a severity, a plain-language explanation, an optional location and an optional remedy. Codes keep their meaning once issued; new failures receive new codes.

code.description: Stable diagnostic code, families MBPF1xx through MBPF7xx.

stage.description: Pipeline step that raised the diagnostic.

remedy.description: Actionable next step; never an invented fallback.
